usageNotes: Use this endpoint to list all cluster-wide directory mappings, which abstract node-local directory paths behind logical IDs for use in VM/container configurations. The caller only sees entries where they hold Mapping.Modify, Mapping.Use, or Mapping.Audit on '/mapping/dir/<id>', so results are permission-filtered. Pass 'check-node' to validate that the mapping configuration is actually correct and usable on a specific node — any mismatches appear as severity-tagged diagnostics in the response.

examples.summary: List all directory mappings and validate them against node 'pve1'

tips: The 'checks' field is absent from each item unless 'check-node' is supplied — always include it when troubleshooting VM startup failures related to directory mounts.
Results are permission-filtered per mapping ID, so an empty list may mean no mappings exist or the caller lacks any Mapping.* privilege.
Use the returned 'id' values as the identifier when calling per-mapping GET/PUT/DELETE endpoints under /cluster/mapping/dir/{id}.
